text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock by its prospects and risk, not only whether it is above or below my purchase price; avoiding a loss is not a sound reason to keep holding.","Selling winners feels satisfying, but taking gains too quickly can limit upside; I should use a consistent plan rather than react to the pleasure of a gain.","Buying Stocks C and D increased my exposure, so I should consider the whole portfolio and keep enough cash instead of treating each stock as a separate account."]}
